bifrost: springboard/src/shell/widgets/mod.rs, springboard/src/shell/today.rs, springboard/src/shell/homeconf.rs, springboard/src/shell/widgetgallery.rs, springboard/src/shell/homeedit.rs, springboard/src/shell/control_center.rs, springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (drawing kit, not WidgetKit)
summary: BifrOSt has shell-owned home-screen and Today widgets (a fixed set of nine kinds, with small and medium sizes, a Smart Stack and an Add Widget gallery) and Control Center toggles, all drawn by the shell. There is no app-facing WidgetKit equivalent: apps cannot ship a widget extension, a timeline provider, a Live Activity, an app-provided control, or a widget intent. The SDK widgets module is a drawing kit for app windows, not a widget API.

features.feature: Widget extension and widget configuration (Widget, WidgetBundle, StaticConfiguration)
features.note: Wave 4 (w4-widgetkit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Widgets are compiled into the shell. No app can register a widget kind, and there is no bundle or extension process.

features.apple: AppIntentConfiguration, WidgetInfo, Migrating widgets from SiriKit Intents
features.note: Wave 4 (w4-widgetkit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. App Intents exist for the control socket, but they do not feed a widget configuration UI. Shell widgets have fixed options set in the shell.

features.feature: Timeline updates (TimelineProvider, TimelineEntry, Timeline, WidgetCenter reload)
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The shell refreshes its own tiles on a schedule. Apps have no timeline or reload call.

features.feature: Widget families and sizes (systemSmall, systemMedium, systemLarge)
features.apple: WidgetFamily, widgetFamily, Supporting additional widget sizes
features.note: Shell has small and medium only. No large size. Apps cannot choose a family.

features.apple: Widget gallery on the Home screen, widget editing
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/widgetgallery.rs, springboard/src/shell/homeedit.rs, springboard/src/shell/homeconf.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/notify/center.rs; springboard/src/shell/services/widgets_timeline.rs (set_placed, set_large)
features.note: Users can place, resize and remove shell widgets from a long-press gallery. Third-party widgets do not appear in it. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/today.rs (search bar, widget tiles, Edit to reorder and switch widgets off)

features.feature: Smart Stacks and relevance (RelevanceConfiguration, TimelineEntryRelevance, WidgetRelevance)
features.apple: RelevanceConfiguration, RelevanceEntriesProvider, TimelineEntryRelevance, WidgetRelevanceAttribute, Smart Stacks
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/relevance.rs, springboard/ui/src/timeline.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/services/widgets_timeline.rs (Store::rows orders widgets with relevance::rank)
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The stack is a manual swipe list of small tiles. It has no relevance scores and no app relevance input. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Dynamic dates and clock content in widgets
features.apple: Displaying dynamic dates in widgets, Text date styles
features.note: Wave 4 (w4-widgetkit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The shell clock tile shows the current time. Apps have no date-styled text in widgets.

features.feature: Widget views (Text, Image, stacks, shapes, gradients, GeometryReader)
features.apple: SwiftUI views for widgets (Text, Image, HStack, VStack, Canvas, Shape types, LinearGradient)
features.note: Apps draw with immediate-mode Surface calls and retained views. There is no declarative widget view layer and no widget-specific layout.

features.feature: Rendering modes and accented or Liquid Glass look (widgetRenderingMode, widgetAccentable, AccessoryWidgetBackground)
features.note: Vibrancy and materials exist for app windows. No accented rendering mode or widget background container.

features.feature: Interactivity in widgets (Button, Toggle, AppIntent in widget)
features.apple: Button, Toggle, Adding interactivity to widgets and Live Activities
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-widgetkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Shell tiles take taps that open the shell's own apps. No widget action invokes an app intent.

features.apple: widgetURL(_:), Link, Linking to specific app scenes from your widget
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-widgetkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Shell tile taps open fixed destinations. Apps cannot give a widget a URL or scene target.

features.apple: ActivityKit, ActivityConfiguration, DynamicIsland, Displaying live data with Live Activities
features.note: Wave 4 (theme-01, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The lock-screen now-playing strip is shell-owned. No app can publish a live activity. process_info activities only keep the system awake and are unrelated to ActivityKit.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/control_center.rs (Airplane, volume, backlight, Rotation Lock toggles); springboard/src/shell/assistive_touch.rs (Action enum)
features.note: Control Center has fixed system toggles only. Apps cannot add controls, and there is no control value provider.

features.feature: Push-driven widget and control updates (WidgetPushHandler, ControlPushHandler, APNs)
features.apple: WidgetPushHandler, ControlPushHandler, Updating widgets with WidgetKit push notifications
features.note: Depends on APNs push tokens, which BifrOSt does not have. Apps can reload nothing in the shell. A local equivalent would be a gap, not a counterpart.

features.feature: Location and network access in widgets
features.apple: Accessing location information in widgets, Making network requests in a widget extension
features.note: No widget process exists, so there is no widget-specific location or network grant. The shell weather tile reads Open-Meteo data directly (springboard/src/shell/weather/mod.rs).

features.apple: Adding accessible descriptions to widgets and Live Activities
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-widgetkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Shell tiles are pixel images with no widget-level label or value for assistive technology.

features.feature: Accessory, watch complication, StandBy, CarPlay and visionOS widgets (AccessoryWidgetGroup, widgetLabel, WidgetTexture, LevelOfDetail)
features.apple: AccessoryWidgetGroup, widgetLabel(_:), widgetTexture(_:), supportedMountingStyles(_:), Adding StandBy and CarPlay support
features.note: Tied to Apple Watch, Lock Screen accessories, CarPlay and Apple Vision Pro hardware or surfaces that BifrOSt does not ship.

features.feature: Xcode previews and debugging (Preview macros, WidgetPreviewContext)
features.apple: Previewing widgets and Live Activities in Xcode, Preview macros, Debugging widgets
features.note: Xcode tooling. BifrOSt has host previews (bifrost pc smoke APP) for app windows, not for widgets.

gaps: No app-facing widget extension: apps cannot register a widget kind, a size or a configuration (Widget, WidgetBundle, StaticConfiguration, AppIntentConfiguration).
No timeline or reload API for apps (TimelineProvider, TimelineEntry, WidgetCenter.reloadTimelines); shell tiles refresh themselves only.
No Live Activity API (ActivityKit, ActivityConfiguration, DynamicIsland); the lock screen shows shell now-playing only.
No app-provided Control Center controls (ControlWidgetButton, ControlWidgetToggle, ControlValueProvider).
No interactive widget actions that run app intents (Button or Toggle invoking AppIntent) and no widget deep links (widgetURL).
No large widget family; shell widgets stop at small (155 pt) and medium (329 pt).
No accented rendering mode or widget container background for the Liquid Glass look.
No widget accessibility descriptions; shell tiles are pixel images.
No relevance input for Smart Stacks; the shell stack is a manual swipe list.
